title: Weld Tech Group - Our Projects
meta_description: Experienced team delivering projects in Poland, Lithuania, Germany, and across the EU. Pipelines, tanks, conveyors, platforms — full service.

main_description.part_2: Thanks to accumulated experience and established business relationships, our projects are implemented on time and within budget, ensuring reliable results and compliance with all legal requirements for our clients.

pipelines.title: Pipeline installation for food and chemical industry companies
items: Installation of advanced systems for transporting liquids, gases, and bulk materials
Compliance with strict safety requirements and hygiene standards
Welding of pipes from stainless and highly alloyed steel, titanium, aluminum, and other materials, taking into account chemical and thermal environment properties

conveyors.title: Manufacturing and commissioning of conveyor systems and rollers
items: Design and manufacturing of conveyors for continuous material transport in food, chemical, and other industries
On-site equipment installation and commissioning, customer personnel training
Integration with existing production lines, taking into account limited space and production process specifications

tanks.title: Manufacturing of tanks for dairy products, beverages, and aggressive environments
items: Manufacturing of tanks of various volumes and configurations — from standard to fully customized solutions
Use of high-quality alloys ensuring corrosion resistance, thermal insulation, and hermeticity
Possibility of installing heating/cooling systems, mixers, and control sensors (temperature, level, pressure, etc.)

platforms.title: Installation of additional and maintenance platforms in the pharmaceutical sector
items: Manufacturing and installation of metal structures meeting sterility requirements and GMP standards
Design of platforms for safe maintenance of technology lines and equipment, including multi-story spaces
Smart solutions optimizing work processes, increasing personnel safety and comfort

quality.title: We use only high-quality materials and equipment

description.part_1: We use only verified metallurgy and work only with reliable suppliers whose materials meet international quality and safety standards. In the selection process, we consider parameters such as chemical composition, mechanical properties, corrosion resistance, and metal product certification.
description.part_2: Thanks to strict controls at all stages — from procurement to preliminary control in production — we can guarantee the stability of metal and alloy properties, which directly affects the longevity and reliability of finished structures.
description.part_3: To ensure high quality and reliability in welding and installation work, our company uses a modern complex of equipment and technologies. We continuously modernize our machine and welding equipment fleet, improving production processes and ensuring stable results even when implementing highly complex projects.
